text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I want to run a small least-priv canary next week to clean up stale admin bindings across a couple of projects. Include KMS admin bindings and ownerless service roles. Plan: 2 projects, 10 bindings each, 72h observation window, automatic rebind if we see any high-sev errors. Thoughts?

alex: Sounds good. Important to set alerting thresholds up-front. What SLOs/alerts should we watch for?

maria: Main signals: failed deploys (401/403 spikes), rollout errors in infra CI, KMS access denied log spikes, and any pager noise from production apps. If any one of those crosses the threshold we rebind immediately.

paige: Re: projects, pick one infra project and one customer-facing app so we test both surfaces. 72h is fine. Add a 1-hour cooldown after a revert to avoid flip-flopping. :thumbsup:

kevin: KMS audit logs — here's a quick Cloud Logging filter we can use to surface denied KMS calls:

```
resource.type="k8s_cluster" OR resource.type="gce_instance" OR resource.type="cloud_function"
protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName:"AsymmetricDecrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt"
severity>=ERROR
protoPayload.status.code=7  # permission denied
```

kevin: Also suggest this IAM scan to find bindings with no recent actor activity (30d):

```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy PROJECT_ID --format=json > iam.json
# then run a short script to cross-reference iam.json principals with audit log last-auth timestamp
```

maria: Nice. For the initial canary I'll pick proj-infra-staging and proj-app-sandbox. I'll tag the owners and set ephemeral removal.

paige: Don't forget to update the runbook: add a KMS-specific rollback step and a notifier to #incidents when we auto-rebind.

sec-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary window created for proj-infra-staging, proj-app-sandbox — window 2026-03-25T09:00Z -> 2026-03-28T09:00Z. Automated watch hooks enabled.

alex: Who's owning the first response if we see a 403 spike?

maria: Kevin will triage KMS/crypto alerts, I'll handle infra CI failures, Paige will watch app health/pager channels.

kevin: I'll add a short detector in the alerting playbook: if KMS denied >5/min sustained for 5m in either project, trigger P1 and rebind.

paige: Can we run a dry-run list first and post the exact principals we plan to touch in this thread? I want to eyeball before any changes.

maria: Yes — I'll post the list tomorrow morning. Dry-run only; no removals until we get :eyes: from each owner.

alex: One more ask — capture a short audit snapshot (export) before the sweep so we can run diff/trend queries later.

maria: Good call. I'll export IAM + KMS bindings and upload to the secure bucket with timestamp and hash.

paige: :thumbsup: thanks.

maria: OK locking plan. Dry-run list tomorrow, canary next Wed, 72h observation, auto-rebind rules in playbook. If anyone sees missing pieces DM me.

kevin: 👍

sec-bot: reminder-bot: please ack the dry-run list when posted so we don't proceed without approvals.
